phases_and_microstructures.name: precipitates at grain boundaries and within grains

evidence.quote: Chemical etching was respon- sible for an overall darkening of the microstructure due to intense precipitation at the grain boundaries and within the grains.

All aspects of the microstructure are covered with spheroidal and very small precipitates. Average diameter of these precipitates increased 50 e300 nm with increasing the time to rupture. Area fraction of precipitates changed from 8.6% to 12.9%.

raised creep strength by the utilization of the reverse transformed austenite phase as a matrix

The minimum creep rates of Fe eNi alloys at 700 /C14 C are found to be much lower than those of the conventional high Cr ferritic heat resistant steels, which is due to ﬁne dispersion strengthening useful even at 700 /C14 C in these alloys.

The addition of boron to the alloy pulled the recrystallization temperature up in the high temperature, and it became a creep test in the un-recrys- tallization condition, and the creep property of high temperature over 700 /C14 C was drastically improved.
